text: Early days, and still lacking many of the features available on the web app (primarily the AI-based features, like the planner), but truly wonderful. it's entirely non-stressful, which is rare -- it doesn't howl about overdue tasks or notifications you didn't specifically ask for. it relies on duration-based, flexible planning, and it doesn't require or invite endless setup.

text: I am so HAPPY! I used Tiimo as I have ADHD and it was the only app that met all my needs. Reminders, colour coding, time blocking, to-do lists, task breakdown and icons, etc. Sadly, it stopped being supported on Android. But it is back! I am over the moon as no other system has worked for me. I can't rate this app highly enough, and I am so happy it is back. I can chuck out those notebooks now!!
author: Querida Gardiner (Mollyandme)
developer_reply: This absolutely made our day 💜 We’re so happy to have you back with Tiimo! Knowing the app truly supports the way your brain works, from reminders to visual planning and task breakdowns is exactly why we do what we do. Thank you so much for sharing this, and enjoy retiring those notebooks 😊

text: I like the app but I wish you could drag and rearrange tasks, be able to snap the same color to multiple subtasks and customize the to-do lists(quick wins, short task, less than an hour)(high priority, medium and low) these dont always make sense for each list. overall I like the at time feature as well as the duration.
